title: Aluwind Infra-Tech Ltd. (NSE Emerge: ALUWIND) — Company Dossier
sector: Industrials / Building Products (facade and fenestration contractor)
archetype: Working-capital-heavy SME facade contractor, cash conversion unproven
primer: Aluwind Infra-Tech makes and installs aluminium windows and facades from one Pune plant, and FY26 revenue of ₹138.6 Cr is six times FY21. Profit is audited, but operating cash flow was negative for three years (₹-37.5 Cr against ₹26.1 Cr of profit) and borrowings rose to ₹46 Cr. Our call for new capital is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT: accumulate only at ₹40.00 to ₹42.00, invalidate on a weekly close below ₹36.95, base value ₹56 against a ₹44.90 close. The chart is Stage 4 and the stock trades about 9,650 shares a day, while the ledger shows no ALUWIND shares, so nothing is held or to be sold. The call turns on Eternia's December 2026 renewal and on H2 FY27 operating cash flow reaching about ₹5 Cr.
holding_rationale: The same-session positions ledger (12 November 2026) shows no ALUWIND shares in any account, so there is nothing to hold, trim or exit. Any future entry should be sized to liquidity first: about 1,000 shares or ₹45,000 at most, and no more than one third of that before the H2 FY27 results, because the stock averages roughly 9,650 shares a day. These are advisory alerts, not broker orders.

gate_exceptions: Session basis. The market_facts build for session 2026-11-13 aborted twice with STALE DATA because the Nifty 50 bar for that date had not been published, so the benchmark ledger, market regime and positions are dated 12 November 2026. The TradingView snapshots for ALUWIND, its peers and the shortlist were pulled at 17:14 Pacific on 13 November, after the NSE close, and reflect 13 November closes: ALUWIND ₹44.90 (+0.9% on the day against ₹44.50 on 12 November), AJMERA ₹133.28 against ₹134.01 in the 12 November ledger, MANORAMA ₹1,984.10 against ₹2,100.10. This report therefore states ALUWIND's price, averages and levels as of the 13 November close, and the market regime and positions as of 12 November.

The first TheWrap Stage 2 dashboard scan (scripts/stage2_scanner.py, minimum market value ₹1,000 Cr) failed with the Chrome PowerBI error 'Could not clear all Stage 2 slicers'; the single retry completed. Because Aluwind's market value (about ₹110 Cr) is below that universe floor, its absence from the Stage 2 list carries no information, and the Stage 4 call rests on the company-specific TradingView snapshot.

We found no published earnings-call transcript or investor presentation for any Aluwind half-year; the public record is results, press releases and exchange filings. The walk-the-talk audit in Chapter 5 therefore relies on prospectus statements, press-release quotes and the annual report, and the CEO-attributed quote used is the Managing Director's FY26 press-release statement.

A literal ten-year financial history does not exist for this company, which listed in April 2024. Chapter 6 uses restated FY21–FY23 figures from the prospectus, the FY24–FY26 annual reports and the H1 FY27 filing instead. Window versus facade revenue, current customer concentration, retention percentages and bank-guarantee amounts are not disclosed.

The options_snapshot.py tool wrote a mean-reversion call-spread sentence in its chart summary for ALUWIND while also reporting NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID (no NSE F&O chain). That sentence was removed from a copy of the tool output before compiling, leaving every number unchanged, because the stock has no listed options; Aluwind is a cash-equity name only. The tool's default business-quality field was not used.

The citation check passes with as-of exceptions for research records dated 31 March 2026 (audited FY26 annual report), 5 May 2026 (the order book in the FY26 press release) and 20 March 2024 (IPO prospectus). These are the latest primary disclosures for those items; the 30 September 2026 half-year filing does not restate them, and the order book was not updated in it.

Review status: BEST_EFFORT_AFTER_REVIEW_LIMIT. Two independent review rounds and a red-team pass were run on the runner's default model (the configured reviewer alias was not selected explicitly). Round 1 returned REVISE with 22 findings and the red team 'verdict_holds' with four revisions; all were addressed. Round 2 returned REVISE with two mechanical findings and several NOTEs, and the red team returned 'verdict_holds'. The two mechanical findings (unlabelled standalone figures in the Chapter 5 KPI table and the '12-month' scenario label) and the return-hurdle wording were corrected after the final round without a third review. Open NOTEs that were not changed: the builder's 'every dollar' sentence, the generic Chapter 8 chart heading, the TACTICAL_MOMENTUM bucket label, identical bull and base interest-cost assumptions, a one-point difference in the L&T share of FY23 revenue between Chapters 2 and 4, and the unreconciled 160,368 and 200,224 sq m capacity figures in Chapters 1 and 5.
